capabilities: Chat with a language model in the sidebar
Read, list, and write notes via the Obsidian API
Attach a selected or linked note as context
Load Total.js reference context and vault skills
disambiguation: Not a general web search or publishing tool; the model only receives text you send and acts on notes via the local Obsidian API.
extras: README is in German. DuckDB view is optional desktop-only and needs duckdb-eh.wasm files copied manually into the plugin folder; they are not shipped via the Community Store. No telemetry; only /v1/chat/completions or /v1/messages and /v1/models are called. Tools, saved conversations, images, and device sync are documented elsewhere. MIT license.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask a language model about your notes and have it act on them locally.

requires.name: UnitedShare API key or your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint

summary: Sidebar chat agent that sends prompts to a local or UnitedShare-hosted model and can read, list, and write vault notes through the Obsidian API.
